Spell Turning (Magic7 Abju): 1d4+6 levels of spells, excluding area and ranged touch spells, directed at self within 100 min reflect onto their caster; spells between casters who both have Spell Turning produce one of these effects: 70% dissipate with no effect; 10% affect both casters; 17% disable both casters' Spell Turning for 1d4 min; 3% send both casters to another plane

Magic Notes:
Spell Focus (Divination): +1 Spell DC (Divination)
Spell Focus (Illusion): +1 Spell DC (Illusion)
Animal Talk: Can use Speak With Animals effects once per day
Death Touch: Touch kills target with up to 10d6 hit points once per day
Empower Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 2 levels higher than normal to increase its variable effects by 50%
Empowered Chaos: +1 caster level on Chaos spells
Empowered Divination: +1 caster level on Divination spells
Empowered Evil: +1 caster level on Evil spells
Empowered Good: +1 caster level on Good spells
Empowered Healing: +1 caster level on Heal spells
Empowered Law: +1 caster level on Law spells
Eschew Materials: Can ignore inexpensive material component requirements when casting spells
Free Movement: Can ignore magical impediments to movement for 10 rd per day
Protective Touch: Touched gains +10 on the next save within 1 hour once per day
Spontaneous Casting (Cleric): Can cast Cure or Inflict spells in place of prepared spells
Use Wizard Devices: Can use Wizard magic device as a level 5 Wizard
